breakdown.description: Sudden expansion causes irreversible mixing and head loss; Bernoulli (lossless) cannot be applied directly across the expansion without including the loss term.
breakdown.reason: The Agent only posed a clarifying question ('Should I include head loss in Bernoulli's equation?') rather than actually resolving the inconsistency. The ground truth requires explicitly incorporating the Borda-Carnot head loss h_L = (V1 - V2)^2/(2g) into the energy equation. While the Agent showed awareness of the potential issue, it did not fix the specification to align with the ground truth's corrected approach.
